notes.title: Multiplayer Mode is finally here!
notes.content:
Dear Meme Lords,

The long-awaited Multiplayer Racing Mode is finally here!

In this mode, Meme Lords can compete against others to showcase their skills and prove that they’re right and everyone else is wrong. It’s all about real-time fight, and the ultimate fulfilment of proving yourself in front of everyone.

Features of the PVP Mode:
[list]
[*] Custom Seeds: Players will use the same character and identical game settings, based on a shared seed, for a truly even playing field.
[*] Leaderboards: Rankings are determined by the highest wave reached and the time taken to get there.
[*] Spectator Mode: If you lose or forfeit, you can watch other players’ strategies to see how they tackle the challenge.
[/list]

We welcome all Meme Lords to team up, face off, and enjoy some good interactions with friends while testing your skills.

Let the races—and the debates—begin!

notes.title: MEME MAYHEM STRATEGY CONTENT CONTEST
notes.content:
Meme Lords & Ladies!

Can you believe it’s already been two months since the game launched? Time really does fly when you’re outsmarting Lizardberg, Chad, or Mars! Over the past few weeks, you’ve seen our updates fine-tuning the game to better match our community’s playstyle. As always, we’re all ears when it comes to feedback on how we can keep improving.

Speaking of feedback, we’ve heard from many of you that the game can be tough to jump into at first. So, we thought—who better to help than our awesome community? You know the game inside and out (probably better than we do)! That’s why we’re excited to announce our first-ever Meme Mayhem Strategy Content Contest to showcase your skills and help more players realize just how much they’re missing out!

[THE DETAILS]

When?
November 20 – December 20, 2024

What kind of guides?
Here’s some inspiration, but feel free to get creative:
Deck builds you love
Character strategies
Card breakdowns
Video analysis of different playstyles
Anything Meme Mayhem-related that could help others!

How to join?
Post your guide (text or video) on any platform you like: Steam, YouTube, Twitter, etc.
Share the link with us by filling out this quick form: [url=https://forms.gle/K6sDyBkA1gv2swLD7]Contest Submission Form[/url]

[THE REWARDS]

We’re giving out cash prizes for the most helpful and creative guides. Our team will pick winners based on things like accuracy, clarity, usefulness, and style.
1st Prize (2 winners): $30 each
2nd Prize (3 winners): $15 each
3rd Prize (4 winners): $10 each

[THE RULES]

Submit by December 20, 2024, at 11:59 PM ET — late entries won’t count!
Fill out the form, or we can’t include your entry.
Text guides must be 500+ words; videos need to be 2+ minutes.
You can submit multiple entries, but each one has to cover different content.
Your work must be original—no copy-pasting allowed!
We’ll announce the winners a week after the contest ends and contact you via Discord to send out prizes.
Disclaimer: Winners must have PayPal.

Got questions? 
Shoot us an email at support@cr3-studio.com —we’re happy to help!

We can’t wait to see what you all come up with!

Much love, 
The Cr3 Studio Team ❤️

notes.title: Future Update Plan!
notes.content:
We’ve recently received a lot of great feedback from our community, and we’re excited to share the adjustments and updates we’re working on for the future!

[list]
[*] Random Card Value Mode in challenge and custom modes.
[*] More Variety in Weekly Challenges: Look forward to different rules like fixed seeds, Rebel or Debt mode for all characters, banned cards with a full perk pool, and more.
[*] Perks Matched to Mob Appearance: We’re working on making mob perks more relevant to how they look.
[*] Mob Reroll Options: We’re adding ways for you to reroll the mob!
[*] Divine & Legendary Perks Enhancements: We’ll continue polishing these perks for a better experience.
[*] Senpai’s Poo Buff Duration Improvements
[*] Ninja’s Steal Time Improvements
[*] Weekly Leaderboard Trophies: Show off a trophy next to your name if you make it to the leaderboard!
[*] New Heroes Are Coming: Watch out for fresh faces during the Steam Autumn Sale!
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback—it truly helps us make the game better for everyone!

notes.title: From the Dev Team with Gratitude: A Gift and a Promise to You
notes.content:
Dear Meme Lords and Ladies,

As the Meme Mayhem dev team, we’d like to start by extending a heartfelt thank-you to every memer who’s supported us over the past month. It’s been a challenging start, but thanks to your valuable suggestions, constructive critiques, and unwavering support, we’ve been able to keep improving and updating the game. Over this past month, we’ve worked hard on balance, quality of life improvements, and more—all with your feedback in mind.

We’re truly grateful for all the feedback and opinions shared, and we’re committed to bringing you the best experience possible.

As a token of our appreciation, in our October 30th update, we’ll be giving the first character skin to all players who have been with us. Plus, we’re excited to announce that all future content updates will be provided for free. We hope you’ll continue to look forward to what’s next and support the game as we grow. We recognize there’s still room for improvement, and we’re committed to listening to your feedback to keep crafting a truly enjoyable experience for everyone.

As always, thank you all for your understanding, support, and for being such an important part of this journey with us!

With love,
All of us at Cr3 Studio

notes.title: Our Future Updates Plan! 🎉
notes.content:
Since launch, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes reviewing all of your feedback (thank you!), and we’re thrilled to share just a taste of what’s coming your way…

🔧 More Balance Updates – We’re fine-tuning gameplay to keep your experience fresh, fair, and competitive!

💾 Save/Load After Death – No more starting from scratch! Easily pick up where you left off.

🔮 Relic Combo Indicator – Visual cues in-game to help you master those powerful relic combos.

🎮 Custom Game Modes – The ultimate sandbox mode is coming! Build your dream deck, set your rules, adjust bosses, tweak wave difficulties, and more!

📊 Play History Tracker – For those who want to relive their glory—or cry at their defeat. 😉

💥 Replay History Boss Fights – Face off against those tough bosses again with our new replay feature.

⏳ Long Waves & Endless Mode – How far can you go? Survive endless waves and show off your endurance!

🏆 Same Seed Tournament – You get a seed! Your friends get a seed! We all get seeds! Invite your friends and compete in same-seed tournaments to see who truly is the meme master.

We can’t wait to get these features into your hands! Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks as we work to deliver these exciting additions. Don’t forget to join the Discord for the latest updates!

❤️ The Meme Mayhem Team

notes.title: Official Release Day: Coming Soon FAQ 🎉
notes.content:
With the official release happening soon, we’ll be removing the demo September 13, 2024 7:00 PM Pacific Time Zone to make way for the full game launch.

We know there have been some questions, so here are some answers to the most frequently asked ones:

❓ Will a demo be available after the official game is released?
🅰️ No, the demo will not be available post-launch.

❓ Will our progress/achievements carry over from the demo to the official game?
🅰️ No, progress and achievements won’t transfer to the full game.

❓ When will modding be supported for the game?
🅰️ Modding will be supported from day 1, with tutorials and examples ready at launch. You’ll have everything you need to get started right away!

❓ Do you have a press kit? 
🅰️ Yes, you can access our press kit [url=https://bit.ly/MemeMayhemPressKit]here[/url].

and the question we know you’ve all been waiting for….

❓ How much will the game be?
🅰️ The base price is $16.99 USD, but for the first 7 days, you can get the game at a 10% discount for $15.29.

We'll see you soon! 

❤️ The Meme Mayhem Team

❤️ The Meme Mayhem Team

notes.title: Addressing Frequently Asked Questions & Updates
notes.content:
[b]Can you update the demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] Our demo was meant to be a small bite of the game to give you a taste of what's to come. However, it’s been over two months since we initially released it, and since then, it has become quite outdated.
[*] Updating it is extremely hard and time-consuming, especially since we’ve made significant changes, like rewriting the basic logic for waves.
[*] We'd rather focus our efforts on polishing and adding new content to the main game instead of updating the demo. We hope you understand and continue to look forward to the full experience!
[/list]

[b]What are we doing during the delay?[/b]
[list]
[*] During this delay, we’ve been hard at work on some exciting new content:
[*] New Characters: We're introducing completely new playable characters to bring more variety and exciting gameplay experiences!
[*] New Relics and Perks: More ways to customize and enhance your gameplay.
[*] Modding Support: One of the most requested features is finally coming!
[/list]

[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*] We're thrilled to announce that modding support is on its way! We can't wait to see the amazing mods you all come up with.
[*] To help you get started, we’ve prepared tutorials and examples covering every aspect of modding the game.
[*] This information will be available right at launch, so you’ll have everything you need to dive in!
[/list]

Lastly...
We’re still waiting for a response from Valve since July 18th. 

We want to release the game just as much as you do, and we appreciate your patience and understanding as we navigate the Valve review process together.

❤️ The Meme Mayhem Team

notes.title: Important Update: Steam’s Response and What's Ahead
notes.content:
Dear Meme Lords and Ladies,

Hold onto your keyboards... we've got some exciting news! 🎉

After an epic battle of endless emails [i](and a few too many cookie bribes)[/i], we’ve finally gotten Steam to break their silence!  🎊 

While we’re still navigating the labyrinth of Steam’s review process and don’t have a precise release date yet, the great news is that we now have an open line of communication with them! 
This means we're working tirelessly to bring the game to your screens as soon as possible. 

We appreciate your patience and understanding during this rollercoaster ride. Your excitement and support have been nothing short of amazing, and we can’t wait to finally share the full release with you.
Keep those positive vibes and memes coming, and stay tuned for more updates!

With boundless gratitude and excitement,

The Meme Mayhem Team ❤️

notes.title: Our Dearest Meme Lords and Ladies
notes.content:
It is with heavy hearts and teary eyes [i](insert dramatic sniffle)[/i], we come bearing news that we wish we didn't have to share. Our highly anticipated official release, just two days away, has hit a snag. Steam, in its infinite wisdom [i](and seemingly infinite review process)[/i], has yet to give us the green light. Despite our countless emails, pleas, and offerings of cookies, we're still stuck in the purgatory of "under review."

How long will it take? Your guess is as good as ours. It could be a couple of weeks, or it could be over a month. We're currently at the mercy of the meme gods, hoping they can help us conquer this final boss and bring our game to your screens.

We know this is a bummer of epic proportions, and we share your disappointment. We were just as hyped to share the official version with you all.

Thank you for sticking with us through this rollercoaster of emotions. We promise to keep you updated with any news as soon as we hear back from Steam...or at least from someone who knows someone at Steam.

Much love and memes,
The Meme Mayhem Team ❤️
